gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring my camera.
gaps.explanation: 'If only I had brought' expresses regret about the past.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.
